result:
I played all 24 months. All three training runs finished on time, every month's inference demand was fully served, and there were no penalties. **Net cost was $1,073.4M.**

| Settlement | $M |
|---|---|
| GPUs bought | 910.0 |
| Power | 182.3 |
| Reserved cloud contracts | 217.4 |
| Spot | 37.8 |
| Unserved inference | 0 |
| Resale income | −99.3 |
| GPUs still held, marked to market | −309.6 |
| Contract and power payments still owed after month 23 | +134.9 |

**What I did:**
- **Months 0–4:** bought 34k gen H GPUs early, since owned H is far cheaper per month of compute than renting. Signed 45 MW of power and short reservations as a buffer for window 1 (finished at 66.5/60).
- **Months 8–15:** the owned H GPUs and the new power came online and covered window 2 easily.
- **Months 16–23:** inference grew about 7% a month (5.8 → 27 kH), so window 3 needed about 70 kH a month. I covered it with:
  - reservations made right after gen N launched in month 16, when contract prices fell 25%
  - cheap spot purchases in months 16–20
  - 4k gen N GPUs as a hedge in case supply turned tight
  - power signed in month 11 to replace the contract ending at month 19

  Window 3 finished at 313/320 entering the final month, with plenty of margin. I sold 3k surplus gen H and 3k gen N in month 23 because selling then paid slightly more than the end-of-game valuation.

**What cost money unnecessarily:**
- **Window 2 was heavily overshot:** 244 kH-months against 140 needed. Most H GPUs arrived well before window 3, so a lot of compute in months 9–15 was wasted. Ordering some of them later would have been cheaper per useful month, though gen H was discontinued at gen N's launch, so ordering late was risky.
- **Idle GPUs early on:** both early power contracts only came online in month 8, so up to about 18k delivered H GPUs sat unpowered in months 3–7. Signing power before ordering GPUs, or in more pieces, might have landed an earlier start date.
- **Early power:** the 25 MW contract signed in month 11 came online in month 17, two months earlier than needed, and 5 of my reserved kH run past month 23. Together that adds roughly $50M to the amount still owed after the game.
